name: bermudan_python_search
candidate_instructions: Edit the complete algorithm.py program and its minimal manifest.json declaration.
Implement fit with: algorithm.py fit --input INPUT_DIR --output MODEL_DIR --seed INTEGER.
Implement predict with: algorithm.py predict --model MODEL_DIR --input QUERY_DIR --output RESULT_DIR.
Expose the CLI bodies as top-level fit(...) and predict(...) functions so structural crossover can compose live function graphs.
The manifest chooses either continuation values or direct decision outputs; both interfaces are valid.
The program may invent its own representation, training objective, optimizer, search procedure, control flow, state, and model files.
Use causal training and query inputs supplied by the evaluator, then write predictions.npy for each query.

directions.mechanism: discard the inherited implementation and generate a complete algorithm from a different principle
directions.prediction: escapes a structurally saturated lineage and changes behavior on several evaluator slices
directions.failure_condition: the restart reproduces the parent behavior or loses under the matched budget
directions.matched_control: rewrite the current parent locally with the same seed and evaluator budget

directions.mechanism: mutate executable control flow, update rules, objectives, or state transitions in one parent
directions.prediction: a structural child improves a targeted slice without relying on a larger budget
directions.failure_condition: the executed behavior is unchanged or the predicted slice does not improve
directions.matched_control: the same parent and seed with no structural mutation

directions.mechanism: combine live function graphs from two behaviorally complementary parent programs
directions.prediction: the child retains a measured strength from each parent and improves aggregate score
directions.failure_condition: one parent is dead code or the child inherits neither predicted strength
directions.matched_control: the stronger parent alone under the same evaluator budget

directions.mechanism: replace one complete fit or predict subsystem while preserving the other as a matched reference
directions.prediction: localizes the causal source of an observed failure and improves its target slice
directions.failure_condition: the targeted failure persists or the untouched subsystem no longer behaves consistently
directions.matched_control: the same parent with both subsystems unchanged

critic_questions: What executable structure is genuinely new relative to both parents?
What observation would separate the proposed mechanism from additional compute?
Which contract slice should falsify the mechanism first?
Should the next candidate mutate this structure, combine it with another parent, or restart from a new program?

engineering_invariants: The candidate owns the complete fit and predict algorithms; the manifest does not select a registered model family.
Each prediction sees only the current path prefix and evaluator-computed immediate payoff.
Continuation and direct-decision programs are evaluated through separate explicit interfaces.
Public and hidden scores come from evaluator-owned paths rather than candidate-reported metrics.
fallback_directions: Generate a fresh whole program from a different algorithmic principle.
Mutate executable branches, loops, objectives, state representations, or update rules rather than only constants.
Combine complementary structures from two successful parent programs and state which behavior each parent contributes.
Use slice feedback to decide whether to revise locally, replace a subsystem, or abandon the current family.
Retain a structure only when its predicted effect survives a matched evaluation.
